title: Plo Koon
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: A Kel Dor from the planet Dorin, Plo Koon had to wear a special device in order to survive in the more common environments in the galaxy, including his home in the Jedi Temple. Considered by many to be one of the wisest Jedi on the Council, it was he who found Ahsoka Tano and brought her into the order as a child. He was shut down on Cato Neimodia by his clones when Order 66 was called.
